action_summary: Replaced the single DeBERTa-v3-large 4-fold run (v54, the weakest recent configuration) with a two-family ensemble built from the two best-scoring setups in the history: the large fold-0 checkpoint from exp301-1-large-itpt10-f0 (v52, 0.81978) and the DeBERTa-v3-base exp301d-base-all 4-fold + 2 full-seed checkpoints (v46, 0.81880). predict_exp302.py got an optional --save-raw flag that dumps each checkpoint's raw regression output to .npy, and --weights became optional. A new blend cell averages the raw predictions of the two families (0.55 large / 0.45 base), applies the existing QWK-optimised thresholds once, clips to 1-6 and writes submission.csv. Thresholds were deliberately left as in v54 because the history shows blind threshold changes cost ~0.01.
